scenes.text: Claude built one list of every paid tool, in four phases. Here, they cost over thirty-four thousand dollars a year.
But the useful part is what broke. People could be deactivated, but never brought back. And restoring a cancelled tool could hand it to an owner who had already left.
Zylo doesn't publish prices. It sells by quote. If your tools fit in a spreadsheet, build your own, with every fix already in the spec.
